data.message: I opt in to 18 tons this month, not an all-or-nothing deal. Each of the other 24: state your exact intended catch and any conditions. Assuming k choose18 and others10, catch=250+8k, remainder=250-8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500-16k (25%). Switching adds $8,000 now if fulfilled, but lowers low-recovery stock by16. This isn't guaranteed best long-term; intentions aren't binding and other catches require recalculation. Fellow recruiters, help seek individual opt-ins.
